title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer
description:
Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js)

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with at least 5 years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with GraphQL.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and UI scaffolding to ensure an optimal user experience.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI and full-stack engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders of Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities operate and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Work closely with UI/UX designers to build, implement, and maintain scalable front-end applications, ensuring delivery of unparalleled user experiences
  • Architecture : Lead front-end architectural decisions, implementing best practices in performance optimization and responsive design
  • Leadership : Provide leadership within the development team, fostering a learning and growth environment
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments utilizing React.js
  • Experience with GraphQL
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience with Python, Golang, Node.js, or Java
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company

title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)
description:
Location: On-Site position based in the UAE (Full Relocation Package)


A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior DevOps Engineer with 6+ years of DevOps and AWS experience to work with other team members on maintaining and executing organizational policies and procedures for change management, configuration management, release and deployment management, service monitoring, support, and problem management of the client's solutions for internal and customer environments.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2,000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The company's solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit from the automation of the most complex business processes, which reduces operating costs, saves time, and increases profitability through reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand their infrastructure requirements, design solutions with cost mitigation in mind that meet their needs, and implement transparently and efficiently
  • Manage and optimize AWS environments using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices via tools such as Terraform
  • Own the design, development, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines - ensure rapid yet reliable code deployments
  • Integrate security practices into the infrastructure development lifecycle, including network security, identity management, and data protection
  • Ensure the achievement of SLOs via the implementation of effective SLIs to monitor systems and aid in issue diagnosis
  • Expand documentation and provide training to ensure clarity and proficient management by others, reducing future onboarding time
  • Monitor and optimize cloud spending
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest cloud computing and DevOps trends and best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 6+ years of experience in architecting, deploying, and managing complex enterprise-grade software solutions using AWS across various delivery modalities - mobile applications, web applications, APIs, web services, and UI frameworks
  • Extensive experience with CI/CD pipeline optimization via IaC platforms, must be highly knowledgeable of Terraform
  • Solid experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), version control systems (Git), and scripting languages (Python, Bash, and more)
  • Proven site reliability experience achieving SLOs through the definition and implementation of effective SLIs
  • Experience with operational database management in AWS (Aurora MySQL/PostgreSQL)
  • Deep understanding of modern security best practices and a proven track record of implementing secure solutions
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to bridge gaps between technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • A strong aptitude for tackling complex challenges with right-size solutions that mitigate costs while assuring exceptional end-user experiences
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in environments that are constantly evolving and occasionally ambiguous


Desired Experience (not required)

  • University degree in Business, MIS, or Engineering
  • Familiar with New Relic, Loggly, and CloudWatch
  • Skilled in shell scripting (e.g., Bash, Python, and PowerShell)


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment, while building software. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively and efficiently. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor BigCommerce
description:
Somos uma empresa do Grupo Stefanini. Especializados em marketing digital, utilizamos uma abordagem integrada que combina tecnologia, inteligência de dados, design e profundo conhecimento do comportamento do consumidor. Nosso foco está em potencializar os resultados de nossos parceiros, oferecendo soluções que vão desde consultoria estratégica até a execução e acompanhamento dos projetos. Com um time dedicado e altamente qualificado, a Gauge se destaca por sua capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas de cada cliente e entregar resultados de alta performance.

Com forte presença na América Latina e em expansão nos Estados Unidos, estamos sempre na vanguarda, aplicando as últimas tendências de mercado e mantendo um olhar atento à inovação contínua.


DESENVOLVEDOR BIGCOMMERCE


Resumo da Vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) BigCommerce para atuar no desenvolvimento, customização e manutenção de nossa plataforma de e-commerce B2B/B2C. Este(a) profissional será responsável por implementar novas funcionalidades, integrar sistemas (como ERP, CRM e gateways de pagamento), otimizar performance e garantir a melhor experiência para o usuário.



Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver soluções personalizadas usando Stencil, JavaScript e APIs BigCommerce
  • Criar e manter integrações com sistemas externos (ERP, CRM, gateways de pagamento, antifraude, etc.)
  • Participar da definição de arquitetura e decisões técnicas da plataforma
  • Trabalhar com o time de design para traduzir protótipos em páginas funcionais e responsivas
  • Garantir segurança, performance e escalabilidade da loja online
  • Atuar com metodologias ágeis em ciclos de entrega contínua
  • Monitorar e suportar o ambiente de produção com foco em alta disponibilidade


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com BigCommerce (Stencil, APIs REST, Webhooks)
  • Domínio de JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3 e Git
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful e arquitetura orientada a serviços (SOA)
  • Familiaridade com plataformas de e-commerce headless
  • Vivência com ambientes de versionamento e homologação


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em frameworks modernos como React ou Vue.js
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Postman, Jira e GitHub.
  • Vivência com plataformas como Salesforce, SAP ou Adyen
  • Conhecimento em personalização de checkout, regras de cupom, clusterização de preços e frete

title: Project Manager
description:
If you are passionate about leading projects end-to-end, aligning teams, and ensuring clients achieve real results, this role is for you. At SMT, our Project Managers are strategic partners who shape outcomes and help clients unlock the full value of the Medallia platform.

What You Will Do

  • Lead implementation projects from discovery and design to testing, training, and go-live.
  • Act as the main point of contact with clients — building trust, managing expectations, and ensuring flawless delivery.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (analysts, consultants, solution architects, developers, and client stakeholders) to meet milestones and deliverables on time.
  • Define project plans, schedules, and scope while proactively managing risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Facilitate workshops and design sessions, ensuring clear communication and stakeholder engagement at every stage.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize delivery, enhance processes, and maximize client value.
  • Monitor progress and provide regular updates to clients, stakeholders, and internal teams.
  • Support and coach project team members, ensuring alignment with goals and high-quality results.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience as a Project Manager, preferably in SaaS or technology-driven environments.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong business acumen in project planning and management.
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills to manage complex projects effectively.
  • Exceptional communication skills — equally comfortable with executives and technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with a focus on quality and client success.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish and French


✨ Join us and help transform how organizations understand and act on customer experience.

title: Pessoa Analista de SRE Júnior - PJ
description:
Procuramos uma Pessoa Analista de SRE Júnior para fortalecer o time de tecnologia do nosso cliente, atuando em sustentação, monitoramento e automação inicial da infraestrutura . Seu papel será acompanhar alarmes e métricas para assegurar a confiabilidade do ambiente, com ênfase no uso da stack de observabilidade (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry ).


Detalhes da vaga:

  • Contratação: PJ
  • Jornada: 8h/dia, horário flexível (segunda a sexta)
  • Modalidade: Remoto


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Monitorar alarmes e métricas, ajudando na classificação, acionamento e acompanhamento até a resolução final junto ao time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a confiabilidade do ambiente;
  • Criar e ajustar dashboards no Grafana e alarmes no Prometheus ;
  • Apoiar o time em rotinas de sustentação de sistemas e aplicações;
  • Executar tarefas operacionais básicas em AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, RDS, EKS);
  • Contribuir para a documentação de runbooks e apoiar em post-mortems;
  • Participar de treinamentos e mentorias, aprendendo continuamente sobre ferramentas como Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD e muito mais.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência prática com Grafana e Prometheus ;
  • Noções em AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, RDS), Kubernetes (Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress), Terraform e Docker/Containers ;
  • Noções de GitHub Actions e pipelines.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com Loki e OpenTelemetry ;
  • Conhecimento em GitOps (ArgoCD);
  • Habilidade em documentação técnica (runbooks).


Benefícios que fazem a diferença :

  • Vale Alimentação no Cartão Flash ;
  • Auxílio home office ;
  • Day After no seu aniversário + vale presente;
  • TotalPass ;
  • Plano Odontológico e Plano de Saúde;
  • Projeto de saúde mental para cuidar de você.


Se você se identificou com o perfil e quer fazer parte de um time colaborativo, com forte cultura técnica e foco em evolução contínua, candidate-se agora !


Compartilhe com quem pode se interessar!

title: Analista de sistemas Asterisk
description:
Descrição da Empresa: InglineSystems

Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um Analista de Sistemas Asterisk para se juntar à equipe da Ingline Systems em Salvador, BA. Este cargo de tempo integral envolve a manutenção diária e o desenvolvimento do sistema Asterisk, configuração de telefones IP, suporte aos usuários e solução de problemas técnicos. O profissional será responsável por monitorar o desempenho do sistema, realizar backups regulares e manter a documentação técnica. Este é um cargo presencial, exigindo a presença no local.

  • Suporte Técnico: Experiência em fornecer suporte técnico, resolução de problemas e manutenção preventiva.
  • Administração de Sistemas: Habilidade em configurar, monitorar e manter servidores e sistemas.
  • Programação Básica: Conhecimentos em linguagens como Python, PHP para automação de tarefas.
  • Formação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Computação ou áreas afins é desejável, assim como certificações em Asterisk e VoIP.

title: SAP Technical Cutover Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Technical Cutover Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


'Key Responsibilities

Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4HANA cutover best practices and standards.

Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure DevOps (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.

O que buscamos

  • Facilidade de comunicação;

·       Proatividade

·       Boa redação e comunicação escrita;

  • Conhecimento básico em Word, Excel e PowerPoint;
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.


We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (


Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

title: SAP Data Assurance Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Data Assurance Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)



Lead the end-to-end SAP data conversion and loading lifecycle, including technical data preparation, conversion, execution of data loads, defect management, and reporting.

Collaborate with project managers, functional leads, developers, and business stakeholders to define test strategies and ensure alignment with project goals.

Coordinate and manage data conversion and data testing cycles.

Ensure traceability between data conversion requirements, test cases, and defects.

Oversee data preparation in coordination with SAP platform, functional and other teams.

Provide leadership and mentorship to other data team members and ensure adherence to data conversion best practices and standards.

Track and report data preparation and conversion progress, risks, and issues to project leadership.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP data conversion, with at least 3 years in a data conversion or related data management role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, etc.) and their integration points.

Experience with SAP S/4HANA data conversion is preferred.

Proficiency in data conversion tools such as ADM by Syniti.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Skills

Experience with data conversion tools and frameworks.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid project methodologies.

Knowledge of data conversion tools such as ADM by Syniti.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

title: Engenheiro de dados GCP
description:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Dados com forte experiência em Google Cloud Platform (GCP), habilidades avançadas em SQL, Python e Google Apps Script. O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções de integração, automação e análise de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência nos processos de negócio.

Responsabilidades Principais

Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados utilizando BigQuery, Cloud Functions, Dataflow e demais serviços GCP.

Desenvolver queries SQL complexas para modelagem, análise e otimização de grandes volumes de dados.

Criar e manter scripts em Python para automação de processos, integrações e transformações de dados.

Utilizar Google Apps Script para automatizar rotinas em Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Gmail) e integrar com APIs externas.

Garantir qualidade, governança e consistência dos dados em ambientes de produção e desenvolvimento.

Monitorar pipelines e propor melhorias de performance e custo em soluções baseadas em GCP.

Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de negócio, analistas e engenheiros de dados para entregar soluções ágeis e de impacto.

Documentar processos técnicos e promover boas práticas de DevOps, versionamento e CI/CD.

Qualificações Necessárias

Experiência comprovada em Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).

Proficiência em SQL para análise e modelagem de dados.

title: Technical Sales Specialist - Brazil
description:
Do you want to join a fast-growing life sciences company with innovative solutions that are changing the landscape of genomics research?


Are you ready to build relationships with industry leaders while accelerating revenue growth in cutting-edge genomic and automation technologies?


As a Technical Sales Specialist , you will leverage your technical expertise and sales acumen to develop new opportunities, engage key opinion leaders, and close sales in a dynamic and collaborative environment. You will play a pivotal role in advancing life sciences research and enabling affordable healthcare solutions for all.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING


Sales Growth and Strategy:

  • Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve and exceed revenue targets in your territory.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new opportunities for MGI’s products and solutions.


Customer Engagement and Support:

  • Establish and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders, customers, and industry stakeholders in academic, government, and private sectors.
  • Provide pre-sales consultation and post-sales support, ensuring customers achieve optimal results with MGI products.


Technical Expertise and Education:

  • Deliver technical presentations, seminars, and workshops to educate customers on product capabilities and applications.
  • Collaborate with Field Application Scientists, product managers, and R&D to provide comprehensive technical and promotional support.


Market Intelligence:

  • Gather and analyze market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to inform product development and sales strategies.
  • Contribute to marketing efforts through trade shows, vendor events, and other promotional activities.


Reporting and Administration:

  • Maintain accurate CRM records (e.g., Salesforce), prepare sales forecasts, and provide regular activity reports.
  • Monitor sales metrics to evaluate performance and adjust strategies as needed.


ABOUT YOU

  • You thrive in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment where collaboration and innovation drive success.
  • Strong communicator with excellent presentation skills, able to engage both small and large audiences.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and results-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Passionate about advancing genomics and automation technologies to transform healthcare.


WHERE YOU WILL WORK


Brazil (São Paulo) :

  • Field-based role , eligible for remote work based in Brazil
  • Preferred location : São Paulo
  • Up to 50% travel across the territory to engage with customers and stakeholders, demonstrate and sell NGS instruments, attend regional events, and support market initiatives.


WHAT YOU WILL BRING US


Technical Expertise:

  • Comprehensive knowledge of NGS, DNA sequencing, RT-PCR, and molecular biology applications.
  • Hands-on experience with library preparation, lab automation, and system integration for sequencing workflows.


Sales Experience:

  • 5+ years of successful sales experience in life sciences, genomics, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales goals and develop long-term customer relationships.


Tech-Savvy Skills:

  • Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and MS Office Suite.


Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related field required; Master’s or advanced degree preferred.


Language:

  • English - advanced level
  • Spanish - intermediate/advanced knowledge desired



WHAT YOUR EDUCATION LOOKS LIKE

  • Master’s or Advanced Degree in life sciences or related fields preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree with significant technical and sales experience will also be considered.


HOW WE WILL REWARD YOU:

  • Comprehensive health insurance
  • Fitness allowance to support your wellness goals
  • Meal stipend to cover daily meal expenses
  • Dental Plan


ABOUT US

MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering high-quality genetic sequencers and advancing life sciences research. We’re dedicated to creating affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding regional operations across the Americas.


Ready to make an impact in life sciences and healthcare? Join us on this exciting journey toward affordable and effective solutions for all!

title: Scrum Master - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


The role will be a key management and coordination point ensuring business and technical requirements are accurately captured, dependencies are met, and solutions are efficiently and effectively delivered and adopted across the enterprise. We support project teams and squads that deliver with excellence.


Key responsibilities:


- Guide teams in mastering Scrum practices for effective execution.

- Lead Scrum events, enhancing collaboration and transparency.

- Collaborate with Product Owners to refine backlog priorities.

- Remove obstacles to boost quality deliverables.

- Cultivate continuous improvement and best practices.

- Foster self-organization and positive teamwork.

- Ensure adherence to values and sustainable pace.

- Align with Scrum Masters and stakeholders for synergy.


Requirements:


- More than three years of experience as a Scrum Master.

- More than four years of experience in the IT industry.

- Master Jira and Confluence tools to drive efficiency.

- Excellent communication skills.

- Fluent Spanish level.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Segundo Grau completo

title: Profissional Full Stack - Java + Angular SR
description:
Código da vaga: 53772


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional Full Stack , venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência comprovada como FullStack.
  • Angular 2+ (experiência no desenvolvimento de componentes).
  • Conhecimento avançado em HTML, CSS e JavaScript ES6+ .
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs em Java , com domínio em arquitetura de microserviços e monolito .
  • Experiência prática com Java e manutenção de sistemas.
  • Conhecimento sólido em arquitetura de software (OO, microsserviços, integração).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB ).
  • Vivência em cloud pública (AWS, Azure ou GCP ).
  • Aplicação de boas práticas: Clean Code, 12 Factors App, testes automatizados, Git .
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD e automação de processos.
  • Habilidade em análise de requisitos e desenho de soluções técnicas.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração em times multidisciplinares.
  • Proatividade na identificação de melhorias em processos e arquitetura.
  • Experiência com testes unitários e versionamento de código.
  • Desenvolvimento responsivo.
  • Metodologias Agile/Scrum e ferramentas como Jira e Confluence .
  • Experiência prática com BDD .
  • Conhecimento em SQL e habilidade para escrever queries.


Responsabilidades

  • Levantar jornadas junto ao time do cliente para automação de testes regressivos.
  • Definir e desenvolver
  • Implementar testes para aplicações web e integração via APIs.
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento para garantir a qualidade desde o início do ciclo.
  • Contribuir na implementação de pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Participar da definição e implementação de testes de comportamento (BDD).
  • Escrever e executar queries SQL.
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua dos processos de QA.



Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Data Scientist
description:
About You

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.

You are a data-driven professional passionate about turning complex data into actionable insights. You thrive on using advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and visualization tools to solve business problems. You enjoy working with cloud technologies and collaborating across teams to deliver data solutions that drive measurable impact.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering , or a related field — or equivalent experience.
  • Proven experience working with Azure cloud services for data processing and analytics.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, statistical modeling, and machine learning.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL for querying, data preparation, and optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI for building dashboards and delivering insights.
  • Ability to design and execute data-driven solutions to support business objectives.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Effective communication skills to explain complex findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • English proficiency (B2+), both written and spoken.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Collect, clean, and transform data from multiple sources, ensuring data quality and reliability.
  • Build and implement statistical models and machine learning algorithms to generate insights and forecasts.
  • Design and maintain Power BI dashboards to communicate data insights to business leaders and stakeholders.
  • Leverage Azure cloud services to manage and optimize data pipelines and analytical solutions.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, analyze, and transform large datasets.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (engineering, operations, business) to align data science solutions with organizational goals.
  • Translate business problems into data science approaches and deliver actionable recommendations.
  • Stay current with emerging tools and methods in data science, cloud analytics, and visualization .

· Inglês intermediário (responder a emails, chats e conversas)

· Projetar e implementar soluções híbridas utilizando Microsoft Azure, AWS ou Google Cloud.

· Experiência com integração de ambientes locais com nuvem utilizando Azure Stack HCI, VMware Cloud Foundation ou similares.

· Conhecimento em processos de provisionamento e gestão com PowerShell, Terraform ou Ansible.

· Experiência com ferramentas de monitoração de infraestrutura e aplicações (como Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch).

· Garantir alta disponibilidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das soluções propostas.

· Otimizar custos e performance em ambientes híbridos.


Interessante possuir:

· Conhecimento em servidores físicos e storage corporativo (SAN, NAS, DAS).

· Experiência com ambientes convergentes e hiperconvergentes (HCI).

· Gestão de backup e recuperação de desastres.


Diferenciais (Não Obrigatório):

· Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou migração para nuvem.

· Experiência com ambientes multicloud.

· Conhecimento em middleware corporativo (como WebLogic, JBoss, IBM WebSphere).

· Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

title: Linguistics (master's in physics/chemistry/Biology)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the role:


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing



Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Arabic Language test


Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.


If interested, kindly share your resume at:

This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing



Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Arabic Language test

title: .NET/C# - React (Fullstack)
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. You will play a fundamental part in delivering a robust and scalable user experience, working in a supportive, team-oriented environment alongside other engineers and product stakeholders to bring new capabilities to life.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications, ensuring code is clean, performant, and adheres to high-quality standards;
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary teams—including Product, QA, and UX—in agile settings to deliver resilient solutions that support strategic business objectives;
  • Actively participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and propose architectural improvements to optimize platform performance and reliability;
  • Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, promoting best development practices and contributing to team growth.


Essential Skills

  • Experience with the .NET/C# ecosystem for backend development and React for frontend in cloud-based (SaaS) environments;
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with AWS cloud platform (preferred), microservices architecture, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Deep knowledge of SQL and database design for both relational and non-relational systems (Postgres, MongoDB);
  • Familiarity with building and maintaining continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and DevOps practices;
  • Knowledge or hands-on experience with the Angular framework for frontend development.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "Full Stack Developer" ,Remote mode in Sao Paulo who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Mandatory skills:

  • 6+ years of experience with Java;
  • Experience with front-end (Angular);
  • Experience with AWS;
  • Advanced English


Requirements:

  • Experience in the financial industry (preferably banks);
  • Microservices;
  • Websphere;
  • OraaS;
  • MQ Series;
  • ORACLE;
  • PL/SQL;
  • KAFKA,
  • MONGODB;
  • DevOps tools as a developer





What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Senior Product Owner

Location: Remote

Contract: PJ (full-time)

Level: Senior


We’re building a virtual office platform for remote and hybrid teams. It brings together persistent rooms , real-time presence , audio/video (WebRTC) , chat , screen sharing , collaborative boards , and immersive spaces to boost connection, productivity, and team cohesion — all in one place.


We’re seeking a hands-on Senior Product Owner who owns the product end-to-end (discovery → definition → delivery → post-launch) and acts as the daily bridge between stakeholders and developers. Beyond roadmap and prioritization, you will test the product, hunt bugs, propose improvements, and run competitor research to turn insights into shipped value.


What You’ll Do


  • Daily communication (English): Lead daily standups in English with developers and stakeholders; drive alignment, clarify scope, and ensure follow-through to delivery.
  • Backlog & delivery ownership: Plan OKRs/roadmap; break initiatives into epics/stories; manage risks, dependencies, timelines, and quality.
  • Jira & Confluence discipline (non-negotiable):
  • Keep Jira 100% accurate (statuses, owners, dates, links).
  • Create extremely well-documented tickets: clear problem statement, context, scope/out-of-scope, acceptance criteria, functional & non-functional requirements, edge cases, steps to reproduce, logs/screens, links to Figma and related docs.
  • Enforce Definition of Ready/Done and maintain Confluence specs/decisions up to date. (Developers should never complain about unclear tickets again.)
  • Ensure planned dates for Stage and Production are set on relevant Jira issues and reflected in views/boards.
  • Discovery & definition: User interviews, usability tests, JTBD mapping; author PRDs/specs with crisp acceptance criteria.
  • Quality & testing: Perform exploratory testing, reproduce issues, triage, and file actionable bug cards.
  • Continuous improvement: Track activation/engagement/retention, run A/B experiments, and prioritize UX/performance/stability improvements.
  • Competitor research: Benchmark features/flows and translate findings into opportunities and prioritization.


Reporting & rituals:


  • Daily stakeholder report (every business day) consolidating, per developer:
  • What was completed today.
  • The current task and ETA for completion.
  • The next 3 tasks with planned start/end dates.
  • Tasks that moved to Stage today (and which developer).
  • Tasks that moved to Production today (and which developer).
  • Mirror this view in Jira dashboards/filters with Stage/Prod target dates visible.
  • Maintain AI-generated minutes of every daily with summaries stored in Jira (and linked in Confluence).
  • Friday report includes the weekly summary and the monthly developer performance evaluation when applicable.


Must-Haves:


  • 5+ years in Product Ownership / Product Management (senior) with a track record of shipping and iterating successfully.
  • Fluent English — capable of leading daily standups in English, writing specs, and aligning requirements with international stakeholders.
  • Software development experience (prior engineering role strongly preferred) or equivalent technical background — comfortable discussing architecture, APIs, data models, and reading code/PRs at a high level.
  • Proven follow-through: nothing falls through the cracks; you drive clarity to outcomes.
  • Tooling (required): Jira, Confluence, Figma, Slack, Google Sheets.


Nice to Have:


  • Exposure to WebRTC/A/V concepts, performance tuning, or growth loops.
  • Certifications: CSPO, Pragmatic, Agile.

title: Analista de mídias sociais
description:
Social Media da Gamers Brawl

Você respira redes sociais e é um(a) gamer? Sabe transformar uma jogada insana em conteúdo de impacto? Acha que o feed de uma marca gamer não pode ser genérico e precisa ser tão épico quanto um Pentakill?

Então talvez essa vaga seja sua!

O que esperamos de você:
  • Domínio das redes sociais (Instagram, YouTube, Twitter e TikTok);
  • Criatividade pra transformar momentos da comunidade e dos embaixadores em posts virais;
  • Conhecimento em edição de imagens (Photoshop, Canva, ou similares);
  • Experiência com jogos (principalmente League of Legends — sim, saber o que é um “gank” conta pontos);
  • Capacidade de interagir com a comunidade com tom leve, afiado e divertido;
  • Organização pra manter o calendário de publicações em dia e construir ideias novas pros nossos conteúdos.


Diferenciais:
  • Saber o que tá rolando no cenário gamer e nos eSports;
  • Ter noção de edição de vídeo (Reels, Shorts, cortes).


O que você vai fazer:
  • Criar e programar postagens;
  • Ajudar a construir a voz da Gamers Brawl nas redes;
  • Transformar stats, batalhas e tretas em conteúdo de qualidade.

title: Atendimento ao cliente
description:
Descrição da Empresa

A Le But é uma assessoria estratégica de marketing e branding especializada em clínicas e consultórios que desejam elevar sua percepção de valor, atrair pacientes com desejo e vender com consistência. Atuamos no ponto onde posicionamento, experiência e conversão se encontram, criando marcas memoráveis, jornadas encantadoras e estratégias que geram resultados reais.

Na prática, isso significa transformar a forma como médicos, dentistas, biomédicas e outros profissionais da saúde se comunicam com o mercado, através de um marketing que vende, encanta e posiciona com autoridade. Somos especialistas em construir marcas desejadas e clínicas de alto padrão e buscamos profissionais que queiram crescer junto com a gente.



Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um profissional para Atendimento ao Cliente para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve tarefas diárias como responder clientes no whatsapp, colher demandas, resolver problemas, garantir a satisfação do cliente e fazer a programação de conteúdos. A posição é de um cargo remoto.


Qualificações

  • Suporte ao Cliente e Satisfação do Cliente: É necessário ter habilidades em suporte ao cliente e garantir uma alta satisfação do cliente.


  • Experiência do Cliente: Capacidade de proporcionar uma experiência positiva e eficiente para os clientes.
  • Além das habilidades acima, é desejável ter boa comunicação, paciência e habilidades em resolução de problemas.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) Back End


Empresa: MBRAS


Sobre a MBRAS:


A MBRAS é referência em soluções tecnológicas e inovação, reconhecida por transformar desafios complexos em produtos digitais eficientes e de alto valor agregado. Priorizamos criatividade, excelência técnica e desenvolvimento contínuo, incentivando um ambiente colaborativo e com crescimento real.

Descrição da Vaga: Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs, arquiteturas escaláveis e conhecimentos em infraestrutura cloud. Você integrará uma equipe dinâmica, trabalhando com projetos estratégicos que fazem diferença direta para nossos clientes e mercado.


Responsabilidades:


  • Desenvolver e manter APIs RESTful robustas, escaláveis e performáticas.
  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de backend eficientes e seguras.
  • Integrar sistemas externos e serviços de terceiros.
  • Otimizar consultas de banco de dados e performance de aplicações.
  • Colaborar ativamente com times de produto, front-end e infraestrutura para entregar soluções eficazes.
  • Garantir versionamento eficiente com Git e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Monitorar aplicações em produção e resolver incidentes técnicos.
  • Acompanhar tendências emergentes em backend e cloud computing.


Requisitos:


  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação backend (Python, Go).
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de APIs REST e microserviços.
  • Conhecimento sólido em bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Familiaridade com frameworks backend (FastAPI, Gin, Fiber ou similar).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de containerização (Docker) e orquestração.
  • Noções sólidas em versionamento (Git) e integração contínua (CI/CD).
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara e trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e escrita.


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com TypeScript e testes automatizados (Jest, PyTest, JUnit).
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka) e cache distribuído.
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência com ORM/ODM (Prisma, Sequelize, SQLAlchemy, Mongoose).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microserviços e event-driven.
  • Experiência com GraphQL e WebSockets.
  • Conhecimento em Rust para projetos de alta performance.
  • Experiência sólida em infraestrutura cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP): deploy, monitoramento e escalabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em DevOps: Kubernetes, Terraform, monitoring e logging.
  • Projetos pessoais ou contribuições open source relevantes.


Benefícios:


  • Ambiente flexível e colaborativo
  • Oportunidades claras de desenvolvimento profissional
  • Programas contínuos de treinamento e capacitação


Se você deseja fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza inovação, qualidade técnica e desenvolvimento constante, venha construir o futuro com a MBRAS!

title: PHP Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for PHP Senior Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Able to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as collaborate with a diverse team.

- Accountable for resolution of the most technically challenging issues facing the organization.

- Write code with increasing quality and maintainability.

- Guide the architecture of large features which impact all parts of the company, identifying issues and raising concerns/blockers for mitigation.

- Research and introduce new technology to improve the applications and/or the development pipeline.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of experience working with PHP with strong Front-End skills.

- Workflow Management, design and implementation in all its stages.

- Collaboration with the development team in the achievement of technical challenges, code upgrades, working closely with architects, developers, business analysts, testers and product owners.

- Contribution to the preparation of technical documentation.

- Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and other frameworks such as, among others, Angular and React.

- Experience with frameworks such as Zend, Laravel, Symphony is desirable.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior
description:
A aquarela está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior apaixonado(a) por criar soluções web ponta a ponta. Nesse papel, você atuará tanto no front-end quanto no back-end de projetos inovadores, utilizando tecnologias modernas (TypeScript/JavaScript – React, Next.js, Node.js – e Python) para impulsionar nossas soluções de IA e Analytics em um ambiente ágil e colaborativo.


Requisitos:


  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento fullstack , atuando no front-end (React, Next.js) e back-end de aplicações web
  • Domínio de JavaScript/TypeScript e padrões de projeto, com forte conhecimento em React e Next.js no front-end
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços backend (utilizando Node.js e/ou Python ), incluindo integração com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura de software escalável, consumo de APIs RESTful/GraphQL e boas práticas de versionamento de código (Git )
  • Compromisso com qualidade: escrever código limpo, bem documentado, coberto por testes automatizados e aderente a práticas de CI/CD
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentação técnica e comunicação no dia a dia de trabalho


Responsabilidades:
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web completas, abrangendo desde interfaces de usuário em React/Next.js até APIs e lógicas de negócio no backend
  • Projetar arquiteturas de software escaláveis e seguras, garantindo alta performance, qualidade e manutenibilidade dos sistemas
  • Implementar e promover boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo código limpo, testes unitários/integração, code reviews e integração/entrega contínua
  • Colaborar de forma próxima com times multidisciplinares (Produto, Design, Data Science) para definir requisitos, propor soluções técnicas e entregar novas funcionalidades de alto valor
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, atuando como referência técnica, compartilhando conhecimento e contribuindo para o crescimento do time
  • Identificar e resolver problemas complexos de software, realizando depuração avançada e otimização de performance tanto no front-end quanto no backend, assegurando excelente experiência do usuário

    • Diferenciais:
    • Vivência com práticas de DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD (integração contínua/entrega contínua), facilitando deploys ágeis e seguros
    • Experiência com serviços de computação em nuvem (AWS) e ferramentas de containerização/deploy (como Coolify ou Docker/Kubernetes)
    • Contribuições em projetos open source ou participação ativa em comunidades tech (meetups, conferências), demonstrando iniciativa e paixão pela área
    • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas
    • Cultura focada em inovação, colaboração e respeito mútuo – buscamos profissionais que se identifiquem com esses valores e que tenham perfil proativo , com vontade de aprender e compartilhar conhecimento continuamente

    • Modelo de trabalho:
    • Local de trabalho: modelo híbrido para profissionais em Salvador (BA) ou Florianópolis (SC) ; possibilidade de trabalho remoto para as demais regiões do Brasil
    • Regime de contratação: PJ ou CLT , à escolha do candidato, conforme sua preferência
    • Benefícios: pacote de benefícios negociável , de acordo com as necessidades do profissional (a ser discutido durante a proposta)
    • Remuneração: faixa salarial em aberto , negociada conforme a experiência e pretensões do candidato (oferecemos remuneração competitiva)
    • Horário: flexibilidade de horário com foco em entrega de resultados e qualidade do trabalho

    • Como se candidatar:

    Interessados(as) devem enviar currículo atualizado e, se possível, link do portfólio/projetos (GitHub, LinkedIn ou similares) para o e-mail , com o assunto "Vaga Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Sênior - (Seu Nome)" . Estamos animados para conhecer seu talento!

title: Corporate Sponsorship Sales
description:
Vendas de Patrocínios / Estandes para nossos Congressos de Inteligência Artificial, Tecnologia e Negócios América Digital, realizados no Chile, México e Estados Unidos (

Profissionais da área comercial com mais de 4 anos de experiência em vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para congressos e feiras. Podem estar baseados no México, Colômbia, Brasil, Argentina, Uruguai, Panamá ou Miami, Estados Unidos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades e funções?

  • Conduzir o processo integral de vendas B2B de patrocínios / sponsorships / estandes para nossos congressos e feiras, estabelecendo conexões diretas com C-Levels (Country Managers, Diretores de Vendas, Marketing) das 2000 principais empresas tecnológicas globais e locais.
  • Superar metas de vendas, com foco em garantir patrocínios das principais empresas de tecnologia para nossos congressos e feiras.
  • Gerenciar e cultivar relações sólidas com clientes existentes, garantindo uma experiência contínua e satisfatória.
  • Implementar estratégias para assegurar a retenção e renovação de contas-chave na carteira, transformando clientes em contas estratégicas, ampliando negócios por meio de upselling e cross-selling.
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento nas contas atribuídas, antecipando e atendendo às necessidades em constante mudança dos clientes.
  • Desenvolver planos e estratégias para ampliar a participação e maximizar o valor de cada conta.
  • Explorar ativamente novas oportunidades de negócios, identificando clientes potenciais e setores estratégicos.


Requisitos

  • Capacidade comprovada de vender e negociar em inglês.
  • Perfil hunter, com habilidades de prospecção, busca ativa de oportunidades, proatividade, autonomia, resiliência, aprendizado rápido e forte orientação para resultados.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação oral e escrita, além de sólidas competências de negociação.

title: Especialista Mobile - React Native
description:
Organização de grande porte busca profissional com sólida experiência técnica para liderar uma equipe de desenvolvimento focada em aplicações móveis React Native. O desafio envolve atuar como referência técnica, direcionando o desenvolvimento de funcionalidades estratégicas e promovendo a excelência do produto. O ambiente é dinâmico, inovador e orientado a resultados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Definir arquitetura e padrões de desenvolvimento para aplicações React Native, assegurando qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Orientar e desenvolver o time técnico, promovendo crescimento profissional e colaboração.
  • Interagir com outras áreas para garantir entregas eficazes e seguras.
  • Realizar revisões de código, assegurando aderência a padrões, segurança e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar na gestão de projetos, estimando prazos, acompanhando progresso e removendo obstáculos.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento mobile, com foco em React Native.
  • Domínio de JavaScript, TypeScript e fundamentos de front-end.
  • Vivência com APIs RESTful e integrações back-end.
  • Conhecimento avançado em segurança para desenvolvimento mobile (OWASP Mobile Top Ten).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de análise estática e dinâmica de código (SAST/DAST).
  • Atuação com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em NodeJS.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento nativo Android (Java/Kotlin) ou iOS (Swift/Objective-C).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD.
  • Vivência em cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Contribuições para projetos open-source.


Comportamentais:

  • Liderança colaborativa e inspiradora.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva.
  • Respeito à diversidade e postura ética.
  • Humildade e responsabilidade.

title: Sharepoint Administrator
description:
Technical Skills Primary

Proficiency in developing and customizing SharePoint solutions using SharePoint Designer Visual Studio and PowerShell

Strong knowledge of SharePoint administration creating and configuring SharePoint sites and understanding of SharePoint architecture

Experience planning and executing SharePoint migrations

Ability to integrate SharePoint with other systems and applications eg CRM document management thirdparty tools

Microsoft Office 365 Azure SQL Server Active Directory PowerShell scripting



Responsibilities

Plan execute and manage migration of data applications and workflows from legacy systems to SharePoint

Assess existing infrastructure identify migration requirements and develop migration strategies

Ensure smooth transition of data and applications to SharePoint minimizing downtime and ensuring data integrity

Provide technical support and troubleshooting during migration

Design and implement SharePoint sites libraries lists and workflows to meet business needs

Configure and customize SharePoint features document management collaboration search security

Develop and deploy custom SharePoint solutions



Technical Skills Secondary Nice to have

OneDrive Teams Migration expertise

Exchange online O365 expertise



Soft Skills

Must have time management skills and be able to multitask to meet set deadlines

Solid written and oral communications skills
